description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard using the ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff by paying {2} and tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Pestered Wellguard ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pestered Wellguard triggers, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.
